customer: Good afternoon, I'm a retiree here in Georgia and I'm thinking of selling my convertible, though I still have a few payments left on the loan. I've also misplaced the title somewhere in the house, so I'm wondering whether I'd need to request a duplicate before selling it to you. I'd appreciate any guidance you can offer.
agent: Thank you for reaching out. As explained in our article "Selling a car you are still paying off," you can sell us your convertible while the loan is still open, and because your lender holds the title or electronic title record, you don't need the title in hand or a duplicate. At the appointment we'll confirm what you owe and pay your lender directly from our offer, and if the offer is more than the payoff, you'll receive the difference (see "When and how you get paid"), while if it's less, please see "If you owe more than our offer." To help things go faster, we suggest getting a payoff letter from your lender before you come in.
